import unittest

from solution import AccountRegistry


class PasswordPreservationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_nonempty_whitespace_password_remains_exact(self):
        registry = AccountRegistry()
        registry.register("user", "u@example.com", " ", "First", "Last")
        self.assertIsInstance(registry.login("user", " "), str)
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError):
            registry.login("user", "")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest

from solution import AccountRegistry


class AccountRegistryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.registry = AccountRegistry()

    def register_alice(self, password='S3cret!'):
        return self.registry.register('  Alice  ', ' Alice@Example.COM ', password, ' Alice ', ' Smith ')

    def test_registration_strips_profile_and_returns_only_public_fields(self):
        profile = self.register_alice()
        self.assertEqual(profile, {
            'username': 'Alice',
            'email': 'Alice@Example.COM',
            'first_name': 'Alice',
            'last_name': 'Smith',
        })
        profile['email'] = 'tampered@example.com'
        self.assertEqual(
            self.registry.profile(self.registry.login('alice', 'S3cret!'), 'ALICE')['email'],
            'Alice@Example.COM',
        )

    def test_duplicate_username_or_email_is_case_insensitive_and_atomic(self):
        self.register_alice()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.registry.register('ALICE', 'other@example.com', 'pw', 'Other', 'Person')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.registry.register('Other', 'alice@example.com', 'pw', 'Other', 'Person')
        token = self.registry.login('aLiCe', 'S3cret!')
        self.assertEqual(self.registry.profile(token, 'alice')['username'], 'Alice')
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            self.registry.profile(token, 'Other')

    def test_login_is_case_insensitive_but_password_is_exact(self):
        self.register_alice()
        first = self.registry.login('aLiCe', 'S3cret!')
        second = self.registry.login('ALICE', 'S3cret!')
        self.assertIsInstance(first, str)
        self.assertTrue(first)
        self.assertNotEqual(first, second)
        self.assertNotIn('S3cret!', first)
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError):
            self.registry.login('alice', 's3cret!')
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError):
            self.registry.login('missing', 'S3cret!')

    def test_profile_requires_live_token_and_returns_fresh_dictionary(self):
        self.register_alice()
        self.registry.register('Bob', 'bob@example.com', 'pw2', 'Bob', 'Jones')
        token = self.registry.login('alice', 'S3cret!')
        first = self.registry.profile(token, 'bob')
        second = self.registry.profile(token, 'BOB')
        self.assertEqual(first, second)
        self.assertIsNot(first, second)
        first['first_name'] = 'Changed'
        self.assertEqual(self.registry.profile(token, 'Bob')['first_name'], 'Bob')
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError):
            self.registry.profile('not-live', 'Alice')
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            self.registry.profile(token, 'nobody')

    def test_edit_renames_owner_and_existing_token_remains_valid(self):
        self.register_alice()
        token = self.registry.login('alice', 'S3cret!')
        edited = self.registry.edit(
            token,
            username='  Alicia  ',
            email=' ALICIA@example.com ',
            first_name=' Ally ',
            last_name=' Smith ',
        )
        self.assertEqual(edited, {
            'username': 'Alicia',
            'email': 'ALICIA@example.com',
            'first_name': 'Ally',
            'last_name': 'Smith',
        })
        self.assertEqual(self.registry.profile(token, 'alicia'), edited)
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            self.registry.profile(token, 'alice')
        self.assertIsInstance(self.registry.login('ALICIA', 'S3cret!'), str)
        edited['username'] = 'tampered'
        self.assertEqual(self.registry.profile(token, 'Alicia')['username'], 'Alicia')

    def test_edit_allows_case_only_changes_and_is_atomic_on_conflict(self):
        self.register_alice()
        self.registry.register('Bob', 'bob@example.com', 'pw2', 'Bob', 'Jones')
        token = self.registry.login('alice', 'S3cret!')
        changed_case = self.registry.edit(
            token,
            username='ALICE',
            email='ALICE@example.com',
            first_name='Alice',
            last_name='Smith',
        )
        self.assertEqual(changed_case['username'], 'ALICE')
        before = self.registry.profile(token, 'alice')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.registry.edit(
                token,
                username='Bob',
                email='new@example.com',
                first_name='Changed',
                last_name='Name',
            )
        self.assertEqual(self.registry.profile(token, 'alice'), before)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            self.registry.edit(
                token,
                username='NewAlice',
                email='BOB@example.com',
                first_name='Changed',
                last_name='Name',
            )
        self.assertEqual(self.registry.profile(token, 'alice'), before)

    def test_logout_invalidates_only_the_given_token(self):
        self.register_alice()
        first = self.registry.login('alice', 'S3cret!')
        second = self.registry.login('alice', 'S3cret!')
        self.assertIsNone(self.registry.logout(first))
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError):
            self.registry.profile(first, 'alice')
        self.assertEqual(self.registry.profile(second, 'alice')['username'], 'Alice')
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError):
            self.registry.logout(first)
        with self.assertRaises(PermissionError):
            self.registry.logout('unknown')

    def test_empty_and_whitespace_validation(self):
        registration_cases = [
            ('', 'a@example.com', 'pw', 'A', 'B'),
            ('A', '   ', 'pw', 'A', 'B'),
            ('A', 'a@example.com', '', 'A', 'B'),
            ('A', 'a@example.com', '   ', 'A', 'B'),
            ('A', 'a@example.com', 'pw', ' ', 'B'),
            ('A', 'a@example.com', 'pw', 'A', '\t'),
        ]
        for args in registration_cases:
            with self.subTest(args=args):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    self.registry.register(*args)

        self.register_alice()
        token = self.registry.login('alice', 'S3cret!')
        for field, value in (('username', ' '), ('email', ''), ('first_name', '\t'), ('last_name', '\n')):
            kwargs = {'username': 'Alice', 'email': 'alice@example.com', 'first_name': 'Alice', 'last_name': 'Smith'}
            kwargs[field] = value
            with self.subTest(field=field):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    self.registry.edit(token, **kwargs)

    def test_every_supplied_value_must_be_a_string(self):
        valid_register = ['User', 'u@example.com', 'pw', 'First', 'Last']
        for index in range(5):
            args = valid_register.copy()
            args[index] = None
            with self.subTest(register_index=index):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    self.registry.register(*args)

        self.register_alice()
        token = self.registry.login('alice', 'S3cret!')
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            self.registry.login(1, 'S3cret!')
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            self.registry.login('alice', None)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            self.registry.profile(None, 'alice')
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            self.registry.profile(token, 1)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            self.registry.logout(None)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            self.registry.edit(token, username='Alice', email=1, first_name='Alice', last_name='Smith')

    def test_plaintext_password_is_not_retained(self):
        secret = 'unique-plaintext-password-4f12d7'
        self.register_alice(secret)
        seen = set()

        def contains_plaintext(value):
            identity = id(value)
            if identity in seen:
                return False
            seen.add(identity)
            if isinstance(value, str):
                return value == secret
            if isinstance(value, dict):
                return any(contains_plaintext(k) or contains_plaintext(v) for k, v in value.items())
            if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set, frozenset)):
                return any(contains_plaintext(item) for item in value)
            if hasattr(value, '__dict__'):
                return contains_plaintext(vars(value))
            return False

        self.assertFalse(contains_plaintext(self.registry))
        self.assertIsInstance(self.registry.login('Alice', secret), str)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
